jobs.title: Computational Biologist

jobs.title: Computational Biologist

jobs.title: Computational Biologist
jobs.description: PhD in a quantitative field, NGS assay and pipeline development experience, strong quantitative and programming skills, Python or R proficiency, and excellent communication and collaboration skills.

jobs.title: Computational Biologist I

jobs.title: Bioinformatician-Computational Biologist

jobs.title: Computational Biologist, Synthetic Spatial Omics

jobs.title: Computational Biologist I, Simmons Cancer Center

jobs.title: Computational Biologist I, Simmons Cancer Center

jobs.title: Associate Computational Biologist, Arthanari Lab
jobs.description: Bachelor's degree in a STEM field; no prior experience required. Requires UNIX/Linux, Python and R familiarity, experimental design knowledge, analytical skills, and effective communication.

jobs.title: Computational Biologist (AI/ML) - Essex Management
jobs.description: 2+ years experience applying AI/ML to biomedical data; proficiency in Python, SQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Git; familiarity with HGVS/VCF and clinical ontologies; strong communication and Microsoft Office skills.

jobs.title: Data Scientist/Computational Biologist
jobs.description: Five years of post-secondary education or relevant experience; PhD strongly preferred. Requires R or Python, genomic data analysis, single-cell and spatial omics, git, Shiny or Connect, TensorFlow or PyTorch, independence, teamwork, and communication.

jobs.title: Scientist, Computational Biology

jobs.title: Scientist II / Senior Scientist, Computational Biology
jobs.description: Ph.D. or equivalent in biology, computational biology, or related science; 2+ years post-Ph.D. experience; extensive single-cell transcriptomics experience; programming skills, preferably Python; strong analytical and communication skills.

jobs.title: Research Scientist - Computational Biologist
jobs.description: Ph.D. in computational biology, bioinformatics, structural biology, computer science, or related field; 0–3 years post-graduate experience; structural bioinformatics, AI/ML modeling, and Python proficiency required.

jobs.title: Research Associate: Computational Biologist (Internal Employment Opportunity)
jobs.description: PhD in genetics, genomics, computer science, or related field; 3 years of postdoctoral computational genome-analysis experience with plant and bacterial pathogens; Phytophthora genomics and HPC cluster expertise required.
